verdict.rationale: Letta documents scheduled tasks that automate prompts to an agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific future time. Cloud agents keep running on their own computer even when the user's laptop is closed, and combining Slack with schedules produces always-on coworkers. Headless mode supports scripted and CI/CD runs, and dreaming runs as background subagents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled or background automations working in practice.
